description: This header defines utility functions within the Utils namespace for synchronizing file contents to storage and persisting JSON settings to files, utilizing file operations and JSON object manipulation.

methods.name: void syncPersistFile(const string file)
methods.description: Synchronizes the given file to persistent storage by opening it, flushing buffers, and calling fsync.

methods.name: void persistJsonSettings(const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
methods.description: Persists a JSON value to a specified file with a key, updating the JSON object stored in the file.

ctags.name: persistJsonSettings
ctags.pattern: /^inline void persistJsonSettings(const string strFile, const string strKey, const JsonValue& jsVa/
ctags.signature: (const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
